data.name: Respawner
data.shortDescription: Lets you respawn enemies in caves, bunkers and villages
data.description:
This mod lets you respawn enemies in caves, bunkers an villages.

In the Menu at "Mods" -> "Respawner" you can select how many enemies should be spawned (min/max) and if it should adhere to the current zones limit.

The limit is predefined by the game and is usually a range per spawn spot. If you disable this limit, you get a more difficult experience.

If the limit is turned on however, you can repopulate the caves as they were at the beginning.

The only limitation is that bosses and individual spawns can not be respawned.
